build_homeview_get: build a flask MethodView that serves index.html or redirects root to tasks
create_homeview_redirect: create a flask view that redirects the root path to a tasks endpoint
test_homeview_get: test the HomeView get method to verify it serves index.html correctly
review_homeview_class: review the HomeView class and its cross-origin enabled get method
refactor_homeview_serve: refactor the HomeView get method to serve static files from a configurable path
